== Ingredients ==

* 1 whole tender [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cleaned
* 3 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] water
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]] or pearl [[Cookbook:Barley|barley]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* Fresh [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* [[Cookbook:Clarified Butter|Clarified butter]], melted

== Procedure ==

# Cut the chicken into quarters, and place in a large pot with the water, rice, and salt.
# Bring pot to a slow [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], removing any scum that rises to the surface. Cook until the chicken is thoroughly done.
# Remove the chicken and place in a serving dish. Garnish with parsley.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the broth.
# Serve the chicken with clarified butter and the hot broth on the side.
